meta_title: AubeSonore · Discovery radio: indie, electronic, hip-hop
meta_description: A free, ad-free discovery web radio: songs you don’t know yet, live, and a page for every artist.
legal_meta_description: Who publishes AubeSonore, what data is kept and why, and the credited sources.
legal_publisher_body: AubeSonore is a non-commercial website published privately by Victor Lenain.
legal_hosting_body: The site and the radio run on a server owned by the publisher, in France. Traffic goes through Cloudflare, Inc. (United States), which protects and routes connections.
legal_data_controller: The data controller is Victor Lenain. Listening to the radio needs no account and creates no personal data.
legal_data_collected: If you create an account, we keep your name, your email address (and your photo if you sign in with Google) and the tracks you keep. To secure your session, we also record your IP address and browser.
legal_data_purpose: This data only runs your account: finding your tracks, playing them on YouTube, and counting your picks in “Most kept” (anonymously). Legal basis: providing the service you ask for. No ads, no profiling, no resale.
legal_data_processors: Providers: Resend sends account emails (confirmation, forgotten password); Google is involved if you choose “Continue with Google”; Cloudflare routes the traffic. Some are based in the United States.
legal_youtube_intro: This site uses YouTube API Services to find the “Play on YouTube” links. By using those links, you agree to the
legal_youtube_privacy_intro: ; your data at Google falls under the
legal_cast: In Chrome, the site loads Google’s Cast SDK to offer casting to your devices; Google then receives your IP address.
legal_data_retention: Your data is kept as long as your account exists, then erased; database backups are kept for 14 days.
legal_data_rights: You can access, correct or export your data, or have your account deleted, by writing to
legal_data_cnil: You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr), the French data protection authority.
legal_cookies_body: The site only sets the cookies needed to keep you signed in. Your browser also stores your volume and language locally. No analytics or advertising cookies.
legal_credits_sources: Artist introductions quote the opening of their Wikipedia article, under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence (creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0): each excerpt links its article, which names its authors. Facts about artists and their links come from MusicBrainz and Wikidata (CC0), their styles from Discogs (CC0), close artists from ListenBrainz listens and Discogs styles (CC0); track covers from Deezer; artist portraits from Wikimedia Commons, each photo naming its author and licence when opened large, or from the Cover Art Archive; record covers from the Cover Art Archive (coverartarchive.org), of which the site keeps a copy to show them without waiting, removed on request. Each cover belongs to its rights holders.
